title: What the reader review caught
scope: Selected recorded reader findings from Paper 1, 19 October 2026. Bounded review; no manuscript edits applied.

coverage.note: Three simulated reader perspectives and metrics; the full story workflow was not completed.

evidence.quote: The manuscript masters were not edited during this smoke run. Status is partial for the full manuscript-story workflow; that label must remain visible even though the three-reader evidence and artifact handover succeeded.

findings.summary: Implementation details obscure the practical task

evidence.quote: All three described losing the practical task amid implementation names, artifact terminology and PRS matching/ancestry mechanics.
The skimmer and both full readers also found Figure 3's obsolete-display disclaimer disruptive.

findings.summary: First-run requirements and genome-build support are unclear

evidence.quote: The potential user could not confidently establish first-run downloads, disk requirements or whether their file's genome build was supported.

findings.summary: A complete question-to-action journey is missing

evidence.quote: The outsider wanted a complete question-to-result-to-next-action journey and a worked interpretation of model disagreement.

findings.summary: Model disagreement lacks a worked interpretation

evidence.quote: The outsider wanted a complete question-to-result-to-next-action journey and a worked interpretation of model disagreement.

findings.summary: An internal opening notice affected the reader response

evidence.quote: The generated reading export includes an internal opening draft notice. The potential user explicitly reacted to it before the Abstract.

limitations: Confirmed here means recorded reader feedback, not established scientific errors.
The readers were simulated agents, not human participants or journal referees.
This selection is not a full manuscript audit; severity was not assessed.
